provenance: Original hand-calculated Tukey fixture authored for OpenStat Mac. No external sample data or software output.
independent_method: For sorted eligible values 1 through 9,17,100, Type 7 positions are (n-1)p. Q1 is halfway between 3 and 4, so 7/2. Q3 is halfway between 8 and 9, so 17/2. IQR=5. Inner fences are -4 and 16. Outer fences are -23/2 and 47/2. Thus 17 is mild and 100 extreme. Raw null and coded -999 are excluded by default.

tolerance.comparison: exact severity codes and row IDs; rational fences, no numeric tolerance
